HF Tektite Grotto Crate 1.why: Region and lid confirmed (audit_overworld #16: Song of Storms lid Land_Kokiri_HidingHoleCover_A_01; tektite pool room). The three adult crates lie on the pool floor at y 120.5 under water whose surface is y ~128.5 (Animal_Fish_Blue at 128.23, Enemy_Tektite_Blue at 128.5): Iron Boots needed, as the region file says. Change only for safety: the crate is broken underwater by rolling into it (BrokenBox DamageParameters: the roll attribute 2444171816 adds 10000 damage), which is how OoTR's own underwater crate (LH GS Lab Crate) is opened (its deadly_bonks clause); bombs and the hammer are not usable underwater, so the can_blast_or_smash half of can_break_crate is unsafe here.
